title: On Using the old road every day
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：use　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 use 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the clerk ① used the old road every day on the same day, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② uses the old road every day before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ use the old road every day at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ used the old road every day before — a line in the file for May 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Using the old road every day on the same day, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ use the daylight to the last hour before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Use the daylight to the last hour at once and never mention it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ uses the daylight to the last hour on the same day every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ used the old road every day again when nobody else would.

⑩ To use the old road every day, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody uses the old road every day before dawn again and somebody must use the old road every day on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 使用（一般过去式 used the old road every day：1993 年书记员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 使用（一般现在 uses the old road every day：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 使用（不定式 to use the old road every day：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 使用（过去完成时 had used the old road every day：1987 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 使用（动名词 using the old road every day 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 利用（use the daylight to the last hour：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去利用把白昼用到最后一刻）
G. v. 利用（use the daylight to the last hour：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 使用（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 uses the daylight to the last hour，而母亲又一次 used the old road every day）

answers.why: use 意为“使用”，1993 年书记员当天就使用天天走那条旧路，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 used。
use 意为“使用”，自那以后书记员天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 uses。
use 意为“使用”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯使用天天走那条旧路”，此处为不定式 to use the old road every day。
use 意为“使用”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 2000 年之前就有人使用过，故用过去完成时 had used。
use 意为“使用”，书记员说“使用天天走那条旧路这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 using the old road every day 作主语。
use 意为“利用”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去利用把白昼用到最后一刻”，should ever 之后用原形 use the daylight to the last hour。
use 意为“利用”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻利用把白昼用到最后一刻（use the daylight to the last hour at once），以后再也不要提起。
use 意为“使用”，新来的申请人每个月份都照例利用把白昼用到最后一刻，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 uses。
use 意为“使用”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就使用天天走那条旧路，用一般过去式 used 叙述。
use 意为“使用”，结尾那句是母亲 2005 年的话：要使用天天走那条旧路，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年，书记员当天就使用天天走那条旧路；办事处里每一个申请人都说这是头一回。（used the old road every day）
多年以后，书记员仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（uses the old road every day）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯使用天天走那条旧路这件事本身。（to use the old road every day）
早在 1987 年就有人使用天天走那条旧路，五月那天卷宗上的一行字就是证据。（had used the old road every day）
书记员说过，当天就使用天天走那条旧路这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（using the old road every day 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻利用把白昼用到最后一刻，以后再也不要提起。（use the daylight to the last hour，祈使句）
answers: In 1993 the clerk used the old road every day on the same day, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the clerk still uses the old road every day before dawn without being asked.
My mother said later that to use the old road every day at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had used the old road every day long before 2000, and the line in the file for May proves it.
Using the old road every day on the same day, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Use the daylight to the last hour at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 use 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the clerk used the old road every day on the same day, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk uses the old road every day before dawn whenever the office asks.
Using the old road every day on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever use the daylight to the last hour before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office uses the daylight to the last hour on the same day every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother used the old road every day again, and the office remembered that half.
